csrf_token.description:
CSRF double-submit token. Send back as `X-CSRF-Token` on
mutating cookie-authenticated requests.

MissingTenantIdResponse.description:
Body returned when `tenant_id` is required (no tenants store
wired) and the client omitted it.

PasswordNotSetResponse.description:
Body returned by `POST /auth/login` when the matched user has no
local password (`password_hash IS NULL`). The SPA reads
`providers` to render "Sign in with GitHub / Google" buttons
without a guess-and-check round trip.

error.description:
Always `"password_not_set"`. Discriminator field; lets clients
pattern-match without inspecting the HTTP status alone.

providers.description:
Provider ids the user has linked. Empty list when no
third-party path is configured (the default
[`crate::NoLinkedProviders`] impl).

Problem.description:
Machine-readable error body.

Mirrors RFC 7807 loosely. The `type` field is a stable string
identifier (`not_found`, `invalid_input`, …) that callers can
switch on; the HTTP status is set by the transport.

title.description: Short human title for the problem.

type.description:
Stable identifier for the error class. Matches lower-case
snake-case of [`crate::error::Error`] variants.

Role.description:
Coarse permission level. Three roles are enough for the common
case; consumers needing more wire their own `Authenticator` and
translate to/from this set at the boundary.

TenantMembershipEntry.description: One membership the user could pick on retry.

role.description: User's role within that tenant (`reader | writer | admin`).

tenant_id.description: Tenant id to echo back in `TokenRequest.tenant_id`.

TenantRequiredResponse.description:
Body returned when the route cannot disambiguate the user's
tenant — multiple memberships exist and the client did not pass
`tenant_id`. The client re-POSTs with `tenant_id` set to one of
the entries below.

memberships.description: One entry per membership row for the authenticated user.

tenant_id.description:
Optional tenant binding. When omitted, the route resolves
the tenant from the user's memberships (requires
[`AuthState::with_tenants`]). See design doc §payload.

expires_at.description:
Absolute UTC expiry (RFC3339). Advisory in v1 — clients
react to 401 rather than pre-emptively refreshing.

token.description:
The plaintext bearer (`sak_<id>.<secret>`). Shown once;
the server stores only the argon2id hash of the secret.

token_type.description:
Always `"Bearer"`. Reserved for the future refresh-token
flow.

info.description: Rubix backend REST surface. See `rubix/docs/design/agent/README.md` for the runtime wiring picture.
info.title: rubix-agent

200.description: Logged in; session + CSRF cookies set

400.description: Account has no local password; sign in via a linked provider
Account has no local password (parity with /auth/login), or tenants store unwired and tenant_id omitted

403.description: tenant_id mismatch with memberships, or no tenant resolvable for a non-admin user

409.description: Multiple memberships exist; client must re-POST with explicit tenant_id

parameters.description: Pass `server` to ask the agent to render the `summary` Diagnostic against the negotiated locale and return it as `rendered_summary` alongside the raw structured form.
parameters.name: render

200.description: Tool invocation succeeded; body is the tool's structured response.

401.description: Unauthenticated (cookie session or API token required when the agent boots with `RUBIX_DATABASE_URL`).

post.summary:
Handler — kept at ≤20 lines. Any growth here is a smell:
domain logic belongs in `rubix-tools` (push into `probe()`),
shaping logic belongs in [`shape_response`].

get.summary:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 with a tiny JSON body — no DB, no
downstream calls. A reachable port is the entire signal.
